# Skill: Cowork — Modular Utility Script Library

**Purpose**: Parameterized, modular scripts for generating consistent Cowork session artifacts — handoff documents, planning files, metadata blocks.

**Owner**: Cowork mode. Also useful for Code/Review agents during manual artifact creation.

**Output location**: Artifacts generated by these scripts go to `Tasks/Handoff/`, `Tasks/Review/`, `Tasks/Manual/`. Decision logging uses `Write-NamespaceLog` → `Tasks/Logs/<namespace>.log`.

**Invocation**: Dot-source the script and call its function, or run directly:
  . Skills/Intake/Scripts/New-CoworkStub.ps1 -Params

---

## Entry Points

| When | Script | Artifact Location |
|------|--------|-------------------|
| Session ends, not final | `New-CoworkStub.ps1` | `Tasks/Handoff/<date>-<topic>.md` |
| Session ends, final | `New-FinalHandoff.ps1` | `Tasks/Handoff/<date>-<topic>.md` |
| Session ends (always) | `New-SessionLog.ps1` | `Tasks/Handoff/<date>-session-log.md` |
| Code changed in Cowork | `New-PostHocPlan.ps1` | `Tasks/Review/<date>-<topic>-posthoc.md` |
| Human action needed | `New-ManualTask.ps1` | `Tasks/Manual/<date>-<topic>.md` |
| Decision logging | `Write-NamespaceLog` (SalmonRun.WorkflowEvents) | `Tasks/Logs/<namespace>.log` |
| Security section | `New-CredentialRef.ps1` | stdout (include in handoff doc) |
| Any file touch | `New-LockHeader.ps1` | The file being modified |

## Scripts

| Name | Description | Key Parameters | Example |
|------|-------------|----------------|---------|
| `New-LockHeader.ps1` | Generate or append Lock Header | `-AgentId`, `-Status` | `New-LockHeader -AgentId "coder-1" -Status locked -OutputPath "plan.md"` |
| `New-CoworkStub.ps1` | Generate cowork-stub handoff | `-Topic`, `-CurrentState`, `-Status` | `New-CoworkStub -Topic "refactor" -CurrentState "..." -Status released` |
| `New-FinalHandoff.ps1` | Generate final handoff | `-Topic`, `-Reason`, `-CompletedItems` | `New-FinalHandoff -Topic "audit" -Reason "context-capacity"` |
| `New-SessionLog.ps1` | Generate session log | `-Topic`, `-Phases` | `New-SessionLog -Topic "dev" -Phases @(...)` |
| `New-PostHocPlan.ps1` | Generate post-hoc plan | `-Date`, `-Topic`, `-Tasks` | `New-PostHocPlan -Date "2026-06-01" -Topic "fix" -Tasks @(...)` |
| `New-ManualTask.ps1` | Generate manual task | `-Topic`, `-Steps` | `New-ManualTask -Topic "AWS IAM" -Steps @("Step 1")` |
| `New-MemoryEntry.ps1` | **DEPRECATED** — superseded by `Write-NamespaceLog` | `-MemoryFilePath`, `-Section`, `-Entries` | `New-MemoryEntry -MemoryFilePath "mem-x.md" -Section "Status"` | Use `Resolve-MemoryRepo` to resolve client repo paths from `_project-map.json` (kept for backward compat) |
| `New-CredentialRef.ps1` | Generate credential ref table | `-Credentials`, `-AwsPath` | `New-CredentialRef -Credentials @(@{Key="K";Purpose="P"})` |

## Invocation Pattern

```powershell
# Dot-source the script to use its function:
. .\Skills\Cowork\Scripts\New-CoworkStub.ps1
New-CoworkStub -Topic "example" -AgentId "coder-1" -Status released -CurrentState "..." -WhatWorked @("A") -WhatDidntWork @("B") -NextActions @("C") -DryRun

# Dry-run to preview output before writing to file:
. .\Skills\Cowork\Scripts\New-FinalHandoff.ps1
New-FinalHandoff -Topic "example" -AgentId "coder-1" -Reason "context-capacity" -CompletedItems @(...) -DryRun
```

## Schema

`Skills/Cowork/cowork-scripts.schema.json` defines the JSON Schema (draft-07) contract for all Cowork scripts. Each script's parameters, outputs, and safety guarantees conform to this schema.
